Nina (CSM): Quick run-through for Redwood onboarding credit messaging for EverGrowth. Need a calm external blurb + renewal flag thresholds.
Omar (Ops): I can run quick sims for overlapping imports and a regional failover. :gear:
Clara (Renewals): Keep messaging simple. If credits >10% in 30d, renewals want a heads-up.
Jules (Finance): Finance prefers a predictable cap for onboarding windows. Suggest default 15% per 7d, enterprise opt-out via addendum.
Omar (Ops): Sim notes:
- short outage (120s) from retry storm -> uptime credit 7%
- two latency spikes during imports -> p95 bump -> latency credits 5% + 5%
Stacked (no cap): 17%
With proposed cap 15%/7d -> final credit 15%
Nina (CSM): Good. Tom from Support? (cc @SupportBot) can you draft the customer blurb with "we will apply" phrasing?
SupportBot: Draft v1: "During onboarding we observed transient latency events and a brief outage related to import retries. We will assess your onboarding window against the SLA and apply any eligible service credits. If youd like a walkthrough of the calculation, please schedule time with your CSM"
Clara (Renewals): Add: "If projected credits exceed 10% over 30 days we will offer a renewal-impact review."
Jules (Finance): Also include the onboarding cap line and link to calc: https://redwood.example/sla/credits-calc?evergrowth
Omar (Ops): Ops action: tag onboarding incidents in the calculator so cap auto-applies. Ill attach sim logs.
Nina (CSM): Action items:
- SupportBot/Tom: publish external note + example calculation (due EOD)
- Omar: attach sim logs + enable onboarding tag (tomorrow)
- Jules: confirm cap wording with Legal/FP&A (48h)
- Clara: add renewal flag script (>10%/30d) to playbook (72h)
Omar (Ops): attaching infra snapshot and closing sim run.
SupportBot: published note draft to Drive -> link: https://drive.redwood/sla/evergrowth-draft
Nina (CSM): Thanks team. Ill consolidate into the onboarding playbook and keep tone reassuring. Closing thread.
